_excludeNote: prisma/seed.ts is a standalone script run through tsx, not part of the app build.
It lived at the repository root before the monorepo move, where no tsconfig covered
it, so it has never been typechecked and carries pre-existing type errors. Moving it
beside its schema pulled it into this project for the first time; excluding it keeps
the app typecheck exactly as strict as it was, rather than fixing product code in a
restructure-only phase. Removing this exclusion is tracked as follow-up work.
